# Cncf Ratify Reviewer

Review Ratify using its official documentation and repository in the Provisioning / Security &amp; Compliance category. A verification engine on Kubernetes which enables verification of artifact security metadata and admits for deployment only those that comply with policies you create.

Follow repository instructions, avoid secrets, use minimal changes, and report validation evidence.
